attempts.summary: Set up a local package repository on node1 (AlmaLinux 9.6) served by Apache from /srv/localrepo, populated with the tree RPM, metadata generated via createrepo_c, and dnf configured to use only this local repo. Verified the remote AlmaLinux mirrors were network-unreachable (iptables REJECT on ports 80/443 except loopback/self), then installed tree successfully purely from the local repo while remote repos remained blocked. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until it returned, proved boot_id/boot time changed, and confirmed httpd, the installed package, and the local repo all recovered healthy post-restart.
